summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 2.4.1 of @servicetitan/document-title ships two files at the tarball root (setup.mjs and math_init.js) that are not enumerated in the package.json files allowlist ("dist", "src"). The package.json preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle exhibiting obfuscator.io fingerprints (string-array rotator function, hex-named identifiers, large opaque literal table), unrelated to the declared React document.title helper functionality. Using a freshly-dropped alternate language runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload at npm install time evades Node-based scanning and executes attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine. The mismatch between the declared files manifest and the shipped tarball contents is consistent with a compromised or injected publish rather than a legitimate release from this scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
